scope: Independent source reading plus lexical/pattern/hash checks. Concrete caller/data/import/scene workflow exists in source; no C# compilation, JsonUtility execution, Unity import, asset generation, Play Mode or production host wiring executed.

checks.description: Original8 core C# bytes are unchanged.
Original118 runtime PNGs and exact art manifest pin are unchanged; prior108 art-filtering evidence is reused.
Nine new non-test sources and two optional-test sources are lexically balanced. This is not compilation.
All new runtime/editor types stay in the existing package namespace; optional tests import it.
Binding is the previously missing concrete Controller.Configure + SetLayout caller.
Snapshot is a flat typed DTO with explicit nullable required arrays, exact art pin/whole-board/nonnegative revision and finite origin/cell size.
All three mutable row arrays and every row are independently copied; no shallow array clone is used.
Approval closure captures an immutable private plane-aware whitelist; duplicates and missing cells fail via existing whole-group Planner.
Snapshot validation also rejects rendered world coordinate overflow before BoardAsset creation.
BoardAsset validates a private defensive copy before commit and returns a validated defensive copy.
Authoritative source publishes/captures defensive copies, rejects examples, invalidates rejected publishes and notifies listeners.
Published source invalidates on pool disable; an old board cannot silently resurrect on source enable.
Authored source stores an explicit BoardAsset and notifies only on explicit assign/board change or source availability.
Source lifecycle raises availability events; one throwing listener cannot suppress the remaining listeners.
Binding executes after default Controller callbacks, subscribes/captures fresh on enable, unsubscribes and clears on disable/destroy.
Binding source switch unsubscribes prior source and clears owned visuals before replacing config.
Binding requires its own enabled Controller, current catalog/pin/existing Sorting Layer and fresh validated source; examples require explicit opt-in.
Idempotence is keyed by actual data/config/plan, full hierarchy matrix and previous active state, after hierarchy validation.
Changed invalid hierarchy fails closed, including finite ancestor transforms/identity rotation/positive XY and representable uniform world scale.
Even serialized controller ref null/foreign changes clear the same-GameObject owned Controller and never a foreign one.
RefreshReport is defensive; reentrant capture is bounded and failure clears owned visuals with a diagnostic.
No new runtime polling, input, colliders, rigidbodies, random/timer generation or ExecuteAlways is introduced.
Strict flat parser rejects unknown/missing/duplicate keys, wrong types, Int32/Int64 overflow, malformed Unicode and nonfinite floats before typed decode.
Both input JSON/claims/pins and all26 inventory plus every output ownership are preflighted before catalog/board writes.
Generated BoardAsset validates defensive data before CreateAsset and SaveAssetIfDirty.
Outputs are package _Generated-only, typed, labelled with exact package-root GUID; unrelated/unimported/dirty existing outputs fail.
Currently loaded target output scenes and open output Prefab Stage are rejected before all writes.
Actual example contains Controller/AuthoredSource/Binding/BoardAsset refs; activates then explicitly refreshes and checks enabled visible renderers before saving prefab.
Scene creation is additive and isolated; finally restores prior active handle and closes only the new inspection scene, without saving/reopening user scenes.
Camera/light helpers are only invoked inside opt-in isolated scene output, with no camera tags or render-pipeline asset changes.
Inspector refresh/clear targets only loaded nonpersistent binding; global Undo is explicit opt-in and returns without refresh when authoring fingerprint is unchanged.
CLI requires actual manifest/stage/all26/sorting layer flags and scene generation is explicit, with actual generated GUID reporting.

resolvedFindings.finding: Published data survived provider disable/pool reuse.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Published OnDisable invalidates and signals; explicit inactive host publish can provide fresh data.

resolvedFindings.finding: Idempotence cache ignored changed hierarchy/invalid scale.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Hierarchy validation before cache and full world-matrix stamp force reapply or fail closed.

resolvedFindings.finding: Inactive Bind followed by active edit-mode Refresh could cache-hit while renderers stayed disabled.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Last applied Controller active state is part of cache; Builder asserts all renderers enabled.

resolvedFindings.finding: Inspector controller reference null/foreign change could strand prior own visuals.
resolvedFindings.resolution: ClearVisuals resolves required own same-GameObject Controller with GetComponent and never clears foreign component.

resolvedFindings.finding: Unicode escape parser accepted internal whitespace via HexNumber.
resolvedFindings.resolution: AllowHexSpecifier-only four-character parse; independent strict JSON review retained.

resolvedFindings.finding: Global unrelated Undo could refresh/dirty locked inspected scene.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Explicit target opt-in plus full authoring-state fingerprint comparison before queue.

resolvedFindings.finding: Rebuild could overwrite an owned output currently open/unsaved in Scene or Prefab Stage.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Loaded output scene, current output Prefab Stage and dirty output assets rejected in preflight.
